contracts.description: Drafts that check enforces continuously and via check --all.

oneOf.description: Path to a draft, checked against the config's own directory.

root.description: Directory the draft describes. Defaults to the config's directory.

templates.description: Template directory. @template(path) values resolve inside it and apply writes their bytes verbatim.

profiles.description: Named policy presets. Writing @name on an entry behaves as if the expanded annotations were written there. Explicit annotations override profile values.

name.description: Annotation name the profile answers to.

doc.description: Shown in editor hover and completion.

expands.description: Annotations the profile carries. Values are a string, an array of items, or null for flags. Profiles may never expand strict or optional, structure stays explicit.

annotations.description: Custom annotation vocabulary. Declared annotations complete and hover like built-ins, and check validates their value shape.

name.description: Annotation name, used as @name in drafts.

value.description: Value shape check enforces. A flag takes no value.

doc.description: Shown in editor hover and completion.

appliesTo.description: Which entries the annotation completes on.
